title: Norway in a Nutshell with FREE Fjord Cruise Ride
highlights: From the scenic fjords of Flåm to the historic charm of Bergen, and the vibrant culture of Oslo, explore the best of Norway, covering its breathtaking landscapes
Enjoy the scenic Flåmsbana railway ride, one of the steepest train journeys in the world, offering unparalleled views of the valley's rugged terrain and spectacular landscapes.
Cruise along the Aurlandsfjord, where you can take in spectacular views of dramatic cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and beautiful villages dotting the shoreline.
Sail along the serene Alversund Streams, where narrow waterways and stunning natural landscapes offer a peaceful escape from the bustling city.
Pass through the narrowest fjord in the world, Nærøyfjord, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its dramatic and towering cliffs.
inclusions: Transfer from Oslo Airport, Gardermoen to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: All Indian nationals are required to carry a valid Government ID proof.
All foreign nationals are requested to carry their passports with them during the tours.
All hotels rooms will be standard by default unless the customer specifies to receive a different category of rooms before booking.
All expenses of a personal nature will be borne by the tourists themselves.
International flights are not included as a part of the package.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Oslo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Oslo! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to the hotel. After you check in, relax for some time. Later, spend the rest of the day at your leisure exploring Oslo. Visit the Norwegian Museum of Cultural History to learn about Norway's rich heritage or wander through local markets for a taste of Oslo's vibrant culture. Later, head to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Norwegian Museum of Cultural History, Oslo
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Oslo Fjord Cruise Experience
days.desc: Start your day by heading to Oslo Cruise Port for an Oslo Fjord Cruise. Experience breathtaking views of Oslo’s coastline, picturesque islands, and landmarks like the Opera House and Aker Brygge. After the cruise, return to the port and make your way back to the hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring Oslo's attractions or relaxing at a local café. Enjoy your evening at leisure, followed by an overnight stay at the hotel.

items.title: Oslo Fjord Cruise Sightseeing on a Shared basis

days.title: Transfer from Oslo to Flam | Norway in a Nutshell Tour
days.desc: After check-out, you'll be transferred to Oslo Train Station to start your Norway in a Nutshell tour. Enjoy a scenic train ride from Oslo to Flåm via Myrdal, featuring breathtaking views of fjords, valleys, and mountains. Upon arrival in Flåm, check in at your hotel and relax. Explore the picturesque village or unwind at the hotel. Enjoy your evening at leisure and a comfortable overnight stay, taking in the serene beauty of this destination.

days.title: Transfer for Flam to Bergen
days.desc: Post check-out, continue your tour. Board a 2 hour cruise from Flam, through the scenic Aurlandsfjord and Nærøyfjord, a UNESCO world heritage site. Later, get transferred to Voss via bus and from Voss to Bergen via overnight train.

days.title: Transfer to Bergen
days.desc: In the morning, you will arrive at the Burgen Railway station. Upon reaching, you will be transferred to the hotel in Bergen. Check-in and spend the day at leisure, or you can visit Bryggens Museum, Vil Vite Bergen Science Center, and many more. Later, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bergen Fjord Cruise to Alversund Streams
days.desc: Begin your day by exploring nearby places at your own pace. In the evening, head to the Bergen Pier to go on a Bergen Fjord Cruise to Alversund Streams and witness the amazing view from the cruise. After the fun-filled day, transfer back to the pier and head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Bergen Fjord Cruise to Alversund Streams

days.title: Transfer to Oslo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel, and get transferred to Oslo. Check-in and spend the day at your own pace. You can explore nearby attractions including Bygdøy, Kon Tiki Museum, and many more. Later, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Post check-out, you will get transferred to the airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your trip.
